mobile_blocks_ast.text_id: 10.1 Protokol Cupping Terstandar SCA & Evaluasi Industri

Standar SCA menetapkan rasio cupping 8.25 g kopi per 150 mL air suhu 93°C (55 g/L), memecah kerak (*crust breaking*) pada menit ke-4, membersihkan busa permukaan, dan mulai menyeruput (*slurping*) lintas suhu ketika cairan mendingin ke 70°C lalu 55°C hingga 35°C.
mobile_blocks_ast.text_en_original: SCA cupping standardizes 8.25 g per 150 mL @ 93°C, crust-breaking at 4:00, skimming, and evaluating Fragrance, Flavor, Aftertaste, Acidity, Body, Balance, Clean Cup, Sweetness & Uniformity as it cools.
